logp.method_description: The octanol–water partition coefficients of the complexes were determined by modification of the reported shake-flask method.36 Briefly, equal volumes of Milli-Q water andn-octanol were shaken together for 72 h to allow the saturation of the two phases. Next, solutions of the complexes were prepared in the saturated water phase (5 × 10-4 M) and an equal volume of octanol was added. Biphasic solutions were mixed for ten minutes and then centrifuged for five minutes at 6000 rpm to allow separation. The concentration of both phases was determined by UV-Vis spectroscopy. The reported log P value is defined as log[complex]oct/[complex]wat and is the mean of three determinations.
